Every name, hour and figure on screen is made up. The hours are the tracker's own schedule; where the branch's real shifts differ, the Day Blocks tab is what changes, not this file.

scenes.headline: You are not on the KPI tracker
scenes.line: Advisors. You are not on the KPI tracker. No blocks. No mail sweep. Your day is your flight plan, your fact finds, and your pipeline.
scenes.tail: The branch measures desks on blocks and advisors on fact finds

scenes.headline: The number is yours, not the branch's
scenes.line: Your flight plan works backwards from what your year has to pay for. Income, down to commission, down to applications, down to fact finds a week. So four a week is your own arithmetic, not a number handed down.
scenes.note: An advisor with no plan on file cannot file a fact find at all: the gate stops it.

scenes.headline: The gap nobody reports
scenes.line: Here is the number no board in this branch has ever put beside the other. Across the year we recommended three point one seven million dollars of cover. We wrote one hundred and fifty two thousand.
scenes.note: Your own figure, not the branch's. The question on Wednesday is which case you re-open first.

scenes.headline: The only account of your day
scenes.line: Nothing else in the branch asks an advisor for their day. So three lines, before you go. What got done. What is in the way. What help you need.
